Care guides and pet safety come from: %1$s. Pet safety isn\'t veterinary advice.

PlantID does not need an account and does not use the internet. When you take or choose a photo, PlantID keeps a temporary copy on this device so it can show it to you; only the most recent one is kept. If you save a result, it stays in History on this device, with a smaller copy of the photo without location data, until you delete it. Nothing is uploaded, and PlantID\'s data is left out of device backups. If you export your saved results, PlantID creates a CSV file without photos and you choose where to send it. Photos you take in PlantID are not added to your gallery.
